entities.name: Radek Smoleňák
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Radek Smoleňák is a Czech former professional ice hockey winger. He last played with the Rytíři Kladno of the Czech Extraliga. Smoleňák was selected by the Tampa Bay Lightning in the 3rd round of the 2005 NHL Entry Draft.
